name: Close the M1.5 exit gate (cot re-evidence)
summary: The onboarding-rebuild milestone passed four of its five measured bars decisively. The one open bar — the sleeping cot being understood without prompting — was voided because the tester had been coached in earlier sessions. All the fixes it was waiting on (cot presentation, station pips, the yard rework) have since shipped; the scoring session now rides the pre-release green-tester pass.
requirements: One unprompted fresh-farm session by an adult who has never played, on the tablet
The cot bar scored from the session trace: at least one sleep, unprompted
No regression on the standing bars: dead taps ≤ 12% (current baseline 5%), longest honest stall ≤ 16.3s
Session recorded to playtests/ and verified against its autosave
current_status: Resumed 2026-09-25: work on Player Update 1.1 has begun. Per the designer's 2026-09-02 ruling, no standing fresh-player recruiting happens at this phase — the CEO is the primary playtester, and one genuinely fresh (green) tester is sought before each public feature release; the 2026-09-08 amendment moved that session to the pre-v0.2.1 pass. Everything technical is ready: the build carries the cot dusk-glow, the purpose pips, and the yard rework, and the tablet has the current build. That session double-counts as the human artifact Replay Phase B needs.

plan.step: Ship the cot and station presentation fixes
Deploy current build to the tablet
Find one fresh tester for the pre-v0.2.1 pass
Run the session unprompted; say nothing during play
Score the trace against the bars; if the cot bar passes, M1.5 closes
